anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Head-region temperature drifting down from ~71.9 to 70.5 °C over k=19-20, consistent with a composition front moving
Distillate flow spiked to 0.658 then 0.501 L/h vs steady ~0.41
Transient rise to 3.70 mbar at k=19, back to 2.24; column dP otherwise stable ~2

args.missing_evidence: A distillate composition (GC) measurement; confirmation whether the FT704/PDI702 excursion at k=19 was a sampling/takeoff event or a hydraulic disturbance.
